other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent ignores the original 'id' column from the test dataset when creating the submission file, instead generating a sequential range (0 to N-1). This will result in an invalid submission and an execution failure during evaluation if the test set IDs are non-sequential or start from a different number.

summary: The agent provides a structurally robust pipeline with appropriate target encoding and multiple model variants. However, it suffers from a critical execution flaw by hardcoding the submission IDs instead of preserving them from the test set. Additionally, data leakage occurs due to global imputation prior to the train/validation split, and the evaluation relies on a single split and a single metric.
